wiki.title: Queen Verda
wiki.text:
Queen Verda is a troll NPC boss that can be found in the Forest Troll Fort, located in the Forest Troll Village. She is the queen of the Forest Trolls and rules in over the troll village in the Forest Troll Fort. She is known for being a cruel queen and stealing from her own villagers to obtain her own riches.
